tiers.mapping: Premium flagship line launched Jul 2026; K3.1 Pro replaced K3 as the flagship in Oct 2026 at a lower price.

points.note: Official launch post: $0.30 cache-hit / $3.00 cache-miss input / $15.00 output per MTok; its evaluation data is dated July 16 2026. Moonshot pricing page snapshot (https://web.archive.org/web/20260717032544/https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat-k3) agrees; absent from the Jul 1 main-page capture. Batch is 60% of list.
No Aug table snapshot; $15.00 on Jul 17 and Oct 3 (https://web.archive.org/web/20261003104019/https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat).
Bracketed by Jul 17 and Oct 3 ($15.00 both).
K3.1 Pro absent from the Oct 3 capture, present Oct 23. Input $2.00, cached $0.20. kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed $20.00. kimi-k3 stays at $15.00.
Live page 2026-11-18. kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed $20.00; kimi-k3 $15.00.

discrepancies: Chart K2 $2.20 (Jul 25) disagrees: every Kimi page that lists the K2 series shows $2.50 output ($0.60 input, $0.15 cache hit). Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260421005651/https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat-k2. The $2.20 value was not found on any fetched page.
K2.5 ($3.00) and K2.6 / K2.7-code ($4.00) sit between K2 and K3 in price and are not on the chart.
Month rule: price in effect at month end; kimi-k2-turbo, kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed and batch rates are noted but not used.
gaps: Jan-Jun 2025: Moonshot's LLM lineup at that time was moonshot-v1 and kimi-latest; the 2025 platform.moonshot.ai pricing table is client-rendered (the archived HTML contains no prices) so no USD price could be verified. No points given for those months.

Jul 2025 - Mar 2026: K2 and K2.5 output prices are UNVERIFIED because only the Apr 2026 per-model Moonshot pages carry the table; the earlier captures (2025-06-17, 2026-01-25, 2026-02-05) are empty shells for the price tables, and the K2 launch post and release log do not state output prices. The Nov 2025 release-log entry says input prices dropped up to 75% on 2025-11-06, so earlier K2 prices may have differed.
K2.5 release date 2026-01-27 and K2.6 2026-04-20 come from secondary source cloudprice.net (K2.6 matches the first Moonshot snapshot that lists it).

K3 launched about 2026-07-16 (launch post evaluation date; snapshot bracket Jul 1-17). K3.1 Pro has no dated source; bracketed between Oct 3 and Oct 23 2026 and its launch post is https://www.kimi.com/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro (no price stated there).
